messages:
ana-support: Customer reports intermittent 503s on embeddings and then a billing spike. Happens from serverless (Vercel) using our JS SDK. They saw a response header "x-request-id: req_5X8a1c" once, then several retries and a large token invoice. Need a minimal repro + exact headers/logs to hand to infra.

sam-mleng: OK — we should collect the absolute minimum: the raw curl -v output (headers + body), the SDK debug output (REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1), and the exact request-id or trace header from the failures. Timestamp window too. Also ask for: Node version, SDK version, and whether they're using auto-retries.

dinesh-sre: If billing spike happened after retries, idempotency is suspect. Ask them to check if their client is re-sending identical requests without idempotency-key. Also ask for the server logs: x-rw-trace or x-request-id the server returned (if any).

ana-support: Pasting compact repro snippets to send to customer — tiny curl + Python/JS/Go that do a single embeddings call. Please ask customer to run these once and paste the whole terminal output. Emphasize "do not run in prod repeatedly".

ana-support: curl (captures headers and verbose):

```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input": ["test embed small"], "model": "open-embedding-small-v1"}'
```

ana-support: Ask them to paste the entire curl output including the initial connection logs and response headers. We need any "x-request-id" or "x-rw-trace" lines.

ana-support: Node/JS minimal (uses fetch; set env to get SDK debug):

```js
// run with: REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 NODE_ENV=production node reproduce.js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async () => {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ input: ['test embed small'], model: 'open-embedding-small-v1' })
  });
  console.log('status', res.status);
  for (const [k, v] of res.headers) console.log(k + ':', v);
  console.log(await res.text());
})();
```

ana-support: Python minimal (requests):

```python
# run with: REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 python reproduce.py
import os, requests, json
url = 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings'
resp = requests.post(url, headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')}", 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, json={'input': ['test embed small'], 'model': 'open-embedding-small-v1'})
print('status', resp.status_code)
print('headers')
for k,v in resp.headers.items():
    print(k, v)
print('body')
print(resp.text)
```

ana-support: Go minimal (net/http):

```go
// run with: REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 go run reproduce.go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "io/ioutil"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main() {
  payload := []byte(`{"input":["test embed small"],"model":"open-embedding-small-v1"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings", bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("err", err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println("status", resp.StatusCode)
  for k, v := range resp.Header { fmt.Println(k, v) }
  fmt.Println(string(b))
}
```

sam-mleng: Also include a small network capture to rule out 502/timeout proxy retries: run one request with tcpdump or curl --trace-ascii. If they can't, at least run `curl -v` as above and capture response timing.

dinesh-sre: For SDKs ask them to enable these envs: `REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1` and `REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY=0` (temporarily disable retries) and run the same call once. If the issue disappears with retries disabled, we have a clear path.

ana-support: If they see a 503, copy/paste the entire response headers block. Example failure headers we hunt for:
`x-request-id: req_5X8a1c`
`x-rw-trace: trace_000abc`
`x-retry-after: 2`

ana-support: Quick repro-run checklist for customer (send this as bullet list):
- Run the curl snippet and paste full output.
- Run one of the small SDK scripts with REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1 and paste stdout.
- If possible disable client retries (REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY=0) and re-run.
- Include exact timestamps (UTC) for each run.
- Attach any invoice or billing spike timeframe.

jess-product: Also ask billing for correlation: which billing lines increased (embeddings tokens vs requests). If retries caused duplicate charged tokens we need to add idempotency guidance to docs.

support-bot: Incident template created: INC-2023-REPRO-EMBED-503. Please upload files to the debug bundle upload link: https://redwood-internal/upload-debug (customer can share a link or paste in-thread).

ana-support: Thanks — I'll send these snippets and checklist to the customer now. Will paste any outputs back here.

sam-mleng: If they paste a request id, I can look it up in the logs (give me the UTC minute window). Also tag me if there are multiple request-ids from the same run.

dinesh-sre: If we confirm retries caused double billing, short-term fix: suggest `REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY=0` + incremental backoff with idempotency-key header. Long-term: we should ensure server-side dedupe for embeddings where possible.

ana-support: (customer replied later) — pasted curl output and node debug. Request id seen: req_5X8a1c at 2023-08-18T15:12:03Z. Will paste full logs in upload.

sam-mleng: Got it — starting log search now for req_5X8a1c and any sibling req ids.

end of thread
